provenance.modifications: Historic Columbia River Highway ways stitched along the travel carriageway, heading Gaussian-smoothed (sigma 12 m), positions re-integrated from heading, resampled at 2 m; long straights compressed (none; bridges kept); land elevation from 3DEP low-pass filtered (sigma 30 m), floored at 1 m; bridge decks synthesized (3DEP is bare earth): a straight deck between the land at each end (not measured); lanes simplified to one each way plus shoulders

meta.notes: Baked by tools/gis from osm-pnw-gorge.json. Real Historic Columbia River Highway geometry, gameplay-fied (see provenance.modifications). Regenerate with the bake; never hand-edit.
